# ===== Explanations / refutations

## validate-sdrf WARNING "fetal stage ... not found in ... efo" (both files)
Kept deliberately (batch rule 9: developmental stage from Cellosaurus age). Cellosaurus CVCL_0063 AG = Fetus.
The accurate term is "fetal stage" HsapDv:0000037 (OLS); EFO has no fetal-stage term (OLS search ontology=efo:
only "embryo stage" EFO:0007725, which is a different stage). Curated HEK293(T) SDRFs PXD003929, PXD013508,
PXD001165 use the same value. Warning only; exit 0.

## reconcile aems-lfq BLOCKER labelled_annotated_as_label_free — FALSE POSITIVE
The project-level quantificationMethods list BOTH "MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method"
(PRIDE:0000425) and SILAC. These six runs are the Fig 3B Flag affinity-enrichment LFQ experiment:
Figure_3B_TMEM126A_FLAG_AEMS.zip txt/summary.txt has Multiplicity 1 and no Labels1 for all six raws
(20180725DAS_LF_31..36), and the preprint states "affinity-enrichment and label-free quantitative (LFQ)".
The SILAC runs are in PXD023136-silac.sdrf.tsv (reconcile exit 0 there).

## reconcile aems-lfq MAJOR instrument_contradicted — FALSE POSITIVE
The PRIDE protocol says "Orbitrap Q Exactive plus, Elite or Eclipse instrument" (three instruments for three
sub-experiments); PRIDE instruments list LTQ Orbitrap Elite. Raw headers of all six LF_31..36 files read
"Orbitrap Elite MS" (method DAS_90min 20_rapidCID_upickup.meth, ITMS CID MS2); the Q Exactive Plus header is
only in the three SILAC files (P2RS20180822_SILAC_04..06). Local copies: scratch raw/*.head.

## convert-openms exit 1 (both files): "Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available"
Not a defect of the file structure. MaxQuant 1.6.5.0 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the first/main
search precursor tolerance, no mqpar.xml was deposited, and the cited parameter source (Formosa et al. 2020
Cell Rep) was not retrievable (cell.com bot check; not in PMC). A specific value would be a guess, so the
column is "not available" (campaign precedents PXD014368, PXD006676, PXD024103).
